children: CHEVRON SAYS THE UNPLANNED FLARING IN ITS EL SEGUNDO, CA REFINERY DOES NOT POSE SAFETY RISK TO EITHER THE COMMUNITY OR ITS EMPLOYEES AT THE REFINERY
CHEVRON: THE MECHANICAL ISSUE DOES NOT AFFECT REFINERY'S ABILITY TO SUPPLY PETROLEUM PRODUCTS TO REGIONAL CUSTOMERS
CHEVRON: THERE HAVE BEEN NO EXCEEDANCES DETECTED IN THE REFINERY’S FENCE LINE MONITORING SYSTEM
CHEVRON: THE REFINERY EXPERIENCED A MECHANICAL ISSUE RESULTING IN THE INTERMITTENT USE OF THE FACILITY’S SAFETY FLARES

title: Chevron Says El Segundo Refinery Experienced Mechanical Issue Resulting in Intermittent Use of Facility’s Safety Flares
